root.label: Food and Water Watch 2025 U.S. water bill study

events.label: Food and Water Watch 2025 U.S. water bill study

slots.name: water cost increase
slots.sentence: Water costs have shot up across the U.S., with a new study by the nonprofit advocacy group Food and Water Watch showing that households are paying 62% more for water at home than a decade ago.

slots.name: water systems studied
slots.sentence: Food and Water Watch based its findings on data from 500 of the largest community water systems around the country that serve a combined 155 million people.

slots.name: people served
slots.sentence: Food and Water Watch based its findings on data from 500 of the largest community water systems around the country that serve a combined 155 million people.

slots.name: gallons per year
slots.sentence: More specifically, Food and Water Watch looked at how much utilities charged for 60,000 gallons of water, the estimated amount households use for drinking, showering, laundry and similar purposes in a year.

slots.name: average water bill
slots.sentence: The average water bill across the 500 systems Food and Water Watch studied was $531 last year.

slots.name: lowest water bill
slots.sentence: The government-run water system in Hempstead, New York, charged people an average of $133 a year last year, the lowest rate of the systems examined in the study.

slots.name: San Jose average bill
slots.sentence: On the other end of the spectrum is San Jose, California, where the private-sector company San Jose Water charged residents an average of $1,416 in 2025, up 163% from a decade ago, the group found.

slots.name: San Jose bill increase
slots.sentence: On the other end of the spectrum is San Jose, California, where the private-sector company San Jose Water charged residents an average of $1,416 in 2025, up 163% from a decade ago, the group found.

slots.name: Idaho average bill
slots.sentence: The state with the lowest overall bills was Idaho, where three of its largest water systems charged an average of $286 in 2025.

slots.name: highest bill state
slots.sentence: West Virginia, which has some of the highest poverty rates in the country, had the highest bills.

slots.name: American Water average bill
slots.sentence: The two largest systems there, owned by American Water, charged an average of $1,383 a year, according to Food and Water Watch.

slots.name: private system average bill
slots.sentence: Those private companies charged an average of $823 for water in 2025, $329 more than what the public systems charged.
